from fractions import Fraction

left = [Fraction(3),Fraction(1),Fraction(1),Fraction(-2),Fraction(1),Fraction(1),Fraction(1)]
right = [Fraction(-4),Fraction(-4),Fraction(-3),Fraction(2),Fraction(2),Fraction(1)]

def trim(p):
    while p and p[-1] == 0:
        p.pop()
    return p or [Fraction(0)]

def deg(p):
    p=trim(p[:])
    return len(p)-1 if not (len(p)==1 and p[0]==0) else -1

def add(a,b,sa=1,sb=1):
    n=max(len(a),len(b))
    res=[Fraction(0)]*n
    for i in range(n):
        if i < len(a): res[i]+=sa*a[i]
        if i < len(b): res[i]+=sb*b[i]
    return trim(res)

def mul(a,b):
    if a==[Fraction(0)] or b==[Fraction(0)]: return [Fraction(0)]
    res=[Fraction(0)]*(len(a)+len(b)-1)
    for i,ai in enumerate(a):
        for j,bj in enumerate(b):
            res[i+j]+=ai*bj
    return trim(res)

def monic(p):
    p=trim(p[:])
    if p==[Fraction(0)]: return p
    lc=p[-1]
    return [c/lc for c in p]

def divmod_poly(a,b):
    a=trim(a[:])
    b=trim(b[:])
    if b==[Fraction(0)]: raise ZeroDivisionError
    da,db=deg(a),deg(b)
    if da<db: return [Fraction(0)], a
    q=[Fraction(0)]*(da-db+1)
    r=a[:]
    lb=b[-1]
    while deg(r)>=db and r"'!=[Fraction(0)]:
        dr=deg(r)
        tdeg=dr-db
        tcoef=r[-1]/lb
        q[tdeg]=tcoef
        sub=[Fraction(0)]*tdeg + [c*tcoef for c in b]
        r=add(r,sub,1,-1)
    return trim(q), trim(r)

def extended_gcd(a,b):
    # returns g,s,t with sa+tb=g and g monic
    r0,r1=trim(a[:]),trim(b[:])
    s0,s1=[Fraction(1)],[Fraction(0)]
    t0,t1=[Fraction(0)],[Fraction(1)]
    while r1 != [Fraction(0)]:
        q,r = divmod_poly(r0,r1)
        r0,r1 = r1,r
        s0,s1 = s1, add(s0, mul(q,s1), 1, -1)
        t0,t1 = t1, add(t0, mul(q,t1), 1, -1)
    # normalize to monic gcd
    lc=r0[-1]
    g=[c/lc for c in r0]
    s=[c/lc for c in s0]
    t=[c/lc for c in t0]
    return g,s,t

g,s,t=extended_gcd(left,right)
print('"'g',g)
print('s',s)
print('t',t)
# verify
lhs=add(mul(s,left), mul(t,right))
print('lhs',lhs)
PY"
